title: King Oliver, Louis Armstrong and the Royal Garden on Rampart Street
summary: He remembers Oliver taking young Armstrong on parades, a raid on the Royal Garden after which Louis took over the band, and the band's lineup.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Do you remember, uh, Joe Oliver, King Oliver?

Yeah, I remember King Oliver. That's the time, I remember when he used to take Louis Armstrong on parades, during the First World War. Louis was in short pants then. And, uh, and I remember when, uh, Joe Oliver used to play at the Royal Garden, at it on Ramport Street. I remember the night he, he, he quit playing and he left here. They, they raided the place and they, a lot of people jumped up the window, a lot of them broke their legs and things.
Oh really, they broke, I heard about that raid, yeah.
Yeah, and that's why Louis Armstrong took the band over after, after he left. Louis took the band over.
Keep on, that's all right. And, uh, was that named the Royal Garden? Or what was the name of that place?
Is that near, uh, Grab here, up in that, uh, uh, That's right, that's right. Near the Pelican across the town.
Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Um. And Louis, he took the band over after, after Joe had left from here. I can remember a lot of the fellas played with Louis. It was Kid Oral. Oh yeah.
Johnny Dots. Uh, can we stop just a second here?
Talking about the place on Rampart Street, Johnny Dots and Ori, you say, Ori, with the Oliver at that time.

Yeah, and Johnny Sencio, he was playing, uh, guitar with him. Uh, banjo in that time. They was using banjos and a bunch of guitars. And, uh, Louis had, uh, I think the Six Piece band they had in that time, Six Piece band, had Bob Lyon on bass. Oh yeah.

You heard you talk about Bob Lyon? Yeah. He was on bass. And had Rayd Happy on drums. I forgot Rayd Happy's, uh, right name. I think Bolton, wasn't it? Yeah, I think that his name is Bolton. After Bob. And they had him on drums. And later on, after, uh, Happy quit the band, I think he went in the show. And, uh, was a kid by the name of Mac. Oh yeah. And he died. And after Mac died, I think, cause Roy, Roy, he, he started playing with him. Little Roy. He was a nice little drummer. He died too. Well, he was quite, quite a, a, a many musicians I know in this time. Yeah. In that time, a lot of them dead out. And then, now I played with Kid Punch.
